subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. Michelle has brought a jar to supper and set it down beside the salt. Something no bigger than a grain of rice is swimming in it, thousands of them. Someone looks at it once and goes on eating. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.jar, version dahl+iyer (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Something in a Jar). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
